chinese-official-mahjong-rules.title: Chinese Official Mahjong Competition Rules (136-tile set)
chinese-official-mahjong-rules.note: Standard set: 3 numeric suits (man/pin/sou) × 9 ranks × 4 copies = 108 tiles, plus 7 honor kinds × 4 copies = 28 tiles, total 136.

in-repo-engine.title: games/boardgame/app/mahjong.js
in-repo-engine.note: TILE_KINDS has 34 kinds and buildWall multiplies them by 4; newRoundState deals 13 tiles to each of 4 seats plus one extra tile to the dealer.

art-guide.title: games/ART-GUIDE.md
art-guide.note: Mahjong tile 26mm high × 19mm wide × 16mm thick; pin pips use blue/green/red, sou is green-dominant, white dragon has a blue-green border.

rules.winCondition: Four melds plus one pair, seven pairs, or thirteen orphans; self-draw or discard claim.

players.basis: Standard table is four seats (East, South, West, North).

handSize.basis: Non-dealers start with 13 concealed tiles; the dealer starts with 14 and discards first.

tile.material: ivory melamine/acrylic face with a beveled edge
